programs.title: Luck
programs.desc: Musa, an underworld kingpin and a firm believer in luck, designs a series of life threatening adventure sports with hefty prize money for people around the world. However, the participants can only survive and win if they are exceptionally lucky.

programs.title: Big Brother
programs.desc: When a girl becomes a victim of acid attack, her mild-mannered brother Dev is enraged. He takes the law in his own hands to teach a lesson not only to her attacker but also to those who victimised other girls in the past in a similar manner.

programs.title: Do Knot Disturb
programs.desc: A man and a woman have to pretend to be a couple in order to salvage a CEO's marriage.

programs.title: Mere Baap Pehle Aap
programs.desc: Gaurav takes great care of his widowed father Janardhan who has single-handedly raised him and his brother with love. Soon, when Gaurav falls in love, he finds out about his father's childhood love and insists that Janardhan gets married first.
